_about: Game Mode settings for GTA V (pipeline/game_signals.py, pipeline/game_moments.py). GTA 6 = a new file like this, no code changes. Regions are [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the 16:9 game picture. Minimap measured on a GTA Online stream (Nov 17, 2026: inside the map, above the health / armour bars, whose green and blue looked like the police); the wanted corner and centre are still estimates.
name: GTA V

colors._about: OpenCV HSV (H 0-179, S and V 0-255). police_red / police_blue: the minimap flashing while the police chase; star: the white wanted stars; wasted_red: the red WASTED / BUSTED word; passed_gold: the yellow-gold MISSION PASSED word.

events._about: Seconds an event lends its weight to before and after it (a WASTED screen ends the action that led to it).
